decision.prompt: A checkpoint reveals that a joist hanger has missing specified nails. What is the strongest response?
options: Pause at a safe point, correct the cause of a joist hanger has missing specified nails, then repeat the specified checks before continuing.
Continue and hide the issue during finishing.
Change the drawing or specification to match the work.
Leave it for the next trade without recording it.
decision.feedback: Do not cover the work; correct the support or fixing and repeat the structural checks.

commonFaults: a joist hanger has missing specified nails
the trimmed opening is out of square
a joist crown is installed inconsistently

questions.prompt: Why is “Mark joist centres and trimmed opening” important on this task?

questions.prompt: How would you check that this work meets the drawing or specification?
questions.guide: Measure centres, diagonals, bearing and level, then visually inspect every hidden fixing.

questions.prompt: What would you do if a joist hanger has missing specified nails?
questions.guide: Do not cover the work; correct the support or fixing and repeat the structural checks.
